title: Bloom festive project plan
body: Milestone: festive stay campaign delivery 17 September 2026. Priority: critical. Design lead Priya Nair. Do not slip this date.

title: Capacity sheet 12 September
body: Design weekly hours 120. Booked 98.4. Utilization 82%. Video internal 40/40. Development 72/80.

title: Video production SOP
body: Final cut requires approved product photography. Do not schedule finishing until assets are in-house and signed off.

title: Northstar rate card
body: Campaign package starting ₹3.8 lakh. Freelance video backup typically ₹18,000 per engagement.

title: Acme retainer SOW
body: Monthly retainer covers account coordination and light organic posts. It does not include a September campaign package, landing page, or video series.

title: Frame & Grain supplier terms
body: Editing starts only on confirmed dates. Cancellations inside 48 hours may still be billed.
